local function SZFCN_fake_script() -- window.Dragify 
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', window)

    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    
    local gui = script.Parent
    
    local dragging
    local dragInput
    local dragStart
    local startPos
    
    local function update(input)
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
    
    gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = gui.Position
    
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    
    gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            update(input)
        end
    end)
end
coroutine.wrap(SZFCN_fake_script)()

local function isValidTarget(plr)
    if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return false end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not root then return false end
    if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return false end
    if char.Parent and char.Parent.Name:lower():find("lobby") then return false end
    
    return true
end

local function getClosestPlayerInWorld(maxDistance)
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = maxDistance or math.huge
    local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isValidTarget(plr) then
            local enemyRoot = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (enemyRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < shortestDist then
                shortestDist = dist
                target = plr
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

local function getClosestPlayerToCursor()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isValidTarget(plr) then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                if dist < shortestDist then
                    shortestDist = dist
                    target = plr
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.Character.Head.Position)
        end
    end

                pcall(function()

                    hrp.Size = Vector3.new(States.HitboxSize, States.HitboxSize, States.HitboxSize)
                    hrp.Transparency = 0.7
                    hrp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
                    hrp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

        end

        LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0)

        if mouseTarget and mouseTarget.Parent then
            local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mouseTarget.Parent) or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(mouseTarget.Parent.Parent)
            if plr and isValidTarget(plr) then
                mouse1click()
            end
        end
    end

    if States.AntiKnockback and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local root = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
        root.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, root.Velocity.Y, 0)
        root.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    end

    if States.KillAura then
        local target = getClosestPlayerInWorld(16)
        if target then
            local tool = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then tool:Activate() end
        end
    end

    -- Tracers Rendering
    if States.ESP_Tracers then
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if isValidTarget(plr) then
                local line = _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr] or Drawing.new("Line")
                line.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
                line.Thickness = 1.5
                line.Transparency = 0.85
                
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    line.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    line.To = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    line.Visible = true
                else
                    line.Visible = false
                end
                _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr] = line
            elseif _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr] then
                _G.PBZ_Tracers[plr].Visible = false
            end
        end
    else
        for _, line in pairs(_G.PBZ_Tracers) do line.Visible = false end
    end

local function populateServerPlayers()
    for _, c in ipairs(PlrListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
    end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local Card = Instance.new("TextButton")
        Card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
        Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
        Card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
        Card.Text = ""
        Card.Parent = PlrListFrame

        local CardCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        CardCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        CardCorner.Parent = Card

        local AvatarImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        AvatarImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
        AvatarImg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
        AvatarImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        AvatarImg.Image = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(plr.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
        AvatarImg.Parent = Card

        local AvatarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        AvatarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        AvatarCorner.Parent = AvatarImg

        local Info = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        Info.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0)
        Info.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0)
        Info.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Info.Text = string.format("%s (@%s)", plr.DisplayName, plr.Name)
        Info.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        Info.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
        Info.TextSize = 9
        Info.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        Info.Parent = Card

        Card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            _G.PBZ_SelectedPlayer = plr
            SelectedLabel.Text = "TARGET: " .. plr.Name:upper()
        end)
    end
end
